name: Darsok Swiftdagger
summary: At the Crossroads, Darsok Swiftdagger keeps watch over the northern trails. The orc scout sends Horde fighters against Witchwing harpies in the Dry Hills, whose raids threaten travelers and settlements. He is also an old friend of Witch Doctor Jin'Zil in Malaka'jin.

sections.title: A Watcher at the Crossroads
sections.body: From the Crossroads, Darsok Swiftdagger watches the northern scrubland. The roads between Durotar, Mulgore, and the Barrens’ northern reaches face raiders and centaur. Organized hunters also descend from the sky. Darsok’s anger is aimed at the Witchwing harpies. Their roosts lie in the Dry Hills, northwest of the Forgotten Pools, where they threaten caravans traveling north.

sections.title: The War on the Witchwing
sections.body: Darsok directs fighters into Witchwing territory, starting with the Harpy Raiders. Next, he sends seasoned fighters after the harpies’ lieutenants. At last, he sends them against their matriarch, Serena Bloodfeather. By breaking their command in stages, he hopes to scatter the flock across the crags.

sections.title: Connections in the Scrub
sections.body: Far northwest of the Barrens, Darsok has an old friend: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil. Jin'Zil is a troll who lives at Malaka'jin in the Stonetalon Mountains, the land the harpies come from. Darsok sends him a letter with news of the harpy campaign. The two friends have not been in touch for many years.

faq.answer: Darsok Swiftdagger keeps watch at the Crossroads, the central Horde settlement in the Barrens. He directs travelers toward threats in the north.
Witchwing harpies roost in canyons northwest of the Forgotten Pools. They threaten Horde caravans, travelers, and scouts on the Barrens’ northern trails.
Serena Bloodfeather leads the Witchwing harpies of the Dry Hills. Darsok sends fighters to kill her and break the flock’s command.

faq.q: What is Darsok's connection to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil?
faq.answer: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil, a troll living at Malaka'jin in the Stonetalon Mountains, is Darsok's old friend. Darsok sends a traveler to Jin'Zil with a letter about the harpy campaign, his first word to him in many years.

faq.q: Does Darsok report to Sergra Darkthorn or Thork?
faq.answer: Darsok organizes his campaign against the harpies from the Crossroads. No Classic source identifies Sergra Darkthorn or Thork as his direct superior.

faq.q: Where do the Witchwing harpies nest?
faq.answer: The Witchwing harpies roost in the Dry Hills, northwest of the Forgotten Pools in the Barrens’ north.

angles.text: As a Horde traveler, you can rely on Darsok’s early, tactical missions to help secure the crossroads trade routes against attacks from above.
As an orc, you can see Darsok’s focused martial approach to securing Kalimdor’s dangerous frontier.
As a rogue, you can recognize Darsok’s preference for precise, lethal strikes against enemy leaders, aimed at taking their heads.
